description: Registered nurse license verification for Texas (a Nurse Licensure Compact state) from the Texas Board of Nursing's open data: license number, name, status, status and expiry dates, issue date, original licensure state, county, advanced practice recognition, board action flag, highest degree and school. Search by license number or name (+ county). Nursys has no open API. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
